answer_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
      LEFT JOIN contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
        ON sl.store_key = s.store_key
      WHERE
        s.country_code = 'IT' AND s.is_online = FALSE AND s.close_date IS NULL
      GROUP BY
        s.store_key
      HAVING
        COUNT(sl.order_key) = 0
    )
    THEN 'yes'
    ELSE 'no'
  END AS answer
